purpose: targeted confirmation of the incremental effect of fixed Procedure content on state-change tasks
selection_disclosure: The boil and freeze families were selected after the v13 pilot localized its directional signal. This experiment tests a targeted mechanism and does not estimate overall ScienceWorld performance.
reuse_disclosure: All six cases reuse official test variations previously evaluated in v11b and are not an independent held-out benchmark confirmation.

condition_definitions.oracle_v3_full: load the complete manually assigned gold v3 Skill
condition_definitions.oracle_v3_metadata: load only Name, Description, and Activation Condition from the same gold v3 Skill
condition_definitions.oracle_v3_placebo: keep the same gold Skill metadata and replace Procedure and Termination Condition with task-irrelevant generic words matched to the original whitespace word count

analysis_plan.reporting: pooled episode results and mean plus standard deviation across the three repeats
analysis_plan.uncertainty: task-variation-clustered bootstrap confidence intervals where supported; exact paired tests reported as descriptive evidence because only six task clusters are present
analysis_plan.interpretation: claim only a state-change-task mechanism; do not generalize to the full benchmark
